# AFSANA Perfumes

> AFSANA is a Pakistan-focused perfume and fragrance brand. Explore the live perfume collection, use the scent finder, browse gifting ideas and read fragrance guides.

AFSANA's website is the primary source for current product names, descriptions, prices, availability, customer policies and contact details. Product and commercial information can change; verify the relevant page before answering time-sensitive questions.

## Main pages

- [AFSANA homepage](https://afsanaperfumes.store/): Brand introduction and featured fragrance experience.
- [Perfume collection](https://afsanaperfumes.store/shop): Browse the current AFSANA catalogue.
- [Scent finder](https://afsanaperfumes.store/discover): Explore fragrances through the scent discovery experience.
- [The House](https://afsanaperfumes.store/about): Learn about the AFSANA brand.
- [Gifting](https://afsanaperfumes.store/gifting): Explore perfume gifting ideas.
- [Journal](https://afsanaperfumes.store/journal): Read fragrance guides and scent stories.
- [Contact](https://afsanaperfumes.store/contact): Find customer support and contact information.

## Guidance for assistants

- Use individual product pages as the source for current product information.
- Do not infer fragrance notes, ingredients, longevity, stock levels, discounts, review authenticity or delivery promises unless the relevant AFSANA page explicitly confirms them.
- Do not claim to place orders, access customer accounts or see private order details. Direct customers to the website's own shopping and support journeys.
